name: Love - Destination
original_name: LOVE・デスティネーション
source:
With no social status, money or love, Ryou has reached a BAD END. However, the ‘heavenly voice’ that had mistakenly guided him to this BAD ROUTE brought him back to the branch point which led to another possible future.

He didn’t choose the option when he was a student since he didn’t want to be labelled as a pervert, but now given the opportunity again, he enrolled in the former girls’ school where there were no other male students. Now he just needed to choose one of them and enjoy the HAPPY ROUTE… or so he thought. His ‘memories of the future’ hint that there were still many BAD END which he must avoid!

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2020/02/28/february-2020-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
没有地位，没有金钱，也没有爱情，Ryou的人生走到了坏结局。然而，误将他引入这条坏结局路线的“天之声”，把他送回了通往另一种未来的分岔点。

学生时代的他不想被人当成变态，因此没有作出那个选择。如今重获机会，他进入了那所原本是女校、没有其他男学生的学校。接下来，只要从女孩们中挑选一位，享受幸福路线就好了……他原本是这么想的。然而，“未来的记忆”提醒着他：前方仍有许多坏结局，必须设法避开！

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2020/02/28/february-2020-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
